topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Oh no, how can this be happening? We promised, didn't we? We said we'd always be there, through everything. Moving across the country? How are we supposed to keep all the promises, make all the plans we talked about, when you're so far away? I mean, it’s a big deal, and I’m thrilled for whatever new adventures await you, but what about us? What about breakfasts at that little café and late-night talks that stretch into the morning? It’s not going to be the same, and I already miss you. Please, promise me we won’t let this change things between us. We can make this work, right? We have to.
